metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.description:
Detects persistence mechanisms created by AI agent runtimes
(OpenClaw, Moltbot, ClawDBot, AutoGPT, BabyAGI).
Focuses on scheduled task creation, service installation, and
registry-based autorun modifications that may indicate long-term foothold attempts.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("openclaw","moltbot","clawdbot","autogpt","babyagi")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "schtasks /create",
    "sc create",
    "reg add",
    "\\Run",
    "\\RunOnce",
    "Startup",
    "New-Service",
    "Set-Service"
)
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), EventCount=count()
    by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
